thread:
olivia: FYI — provisioning failure for ~120 trial tenants created 03:12–04:00 UTC. INC-4123. Some tenants stuck at "provisioning" state, onboarding assets not available. Notified eng oncall.

jamal: Thanks. which customers? need to prioritize high-touch and potential renewals.

sophie: Root cause: race in webhook handler when tenant_create + parallel index job. We pushed a hotfix to retry logic; monitoring shows recovery for new events, but backlog needs manual replay. :wrench:

olivia: Drafting comms to affected accounts. Aim: acknowledge, ETA for remediation, offer immediate workaround, and invite to office hours. Draft below — please suggest edits:

```Hi {first_name},

We detected a provisioning issue that affected recent trial signups between 03:12–04:00 UTC. Your workspace may not have completed onboarding assets. Our team has a fix in place and is replaying the backlog; most customers will be fully provisioned within 24 hours.

If you need immediate access we can run a manual replay or provide a temporary admin token. We're also offering a 7‑day trial extension and a one‑time onboarding session.

Apologies for the disruption — reply here and we'll prioritize you.

Thanks,
Redwood Support
``` 

ravi: +1 to the extension. For customers showing high renewal potential (>$50k ARR) let's escalate to AE for a personal outreach and offer additional credits. Can we get the affected list by EOD?

ava: I'll run the tenant list filter and tag accounts by ARR/renewal date. expected to finish in ~2 hours. Also preparing a short survey to capture frustration points post-recovery.

sophie: Manual replay ETA: started now, about 15m per 100 tenants; we’ll parallelize to bring it under 6h. Will post status updates every 45m. If any manual replays fail, I'll escalate to infra.

deploy-bot: Rollout: hotfix v1.2.3 applied to prod at 04:22 UTC. Monitoring checks green.

olivia: OK—action items:
- ava: deliver affected tenant list + priority tags (ARR/renewal) — due in 2h
- ravi: coordinate AE outreach for top-priority accounts — hold until list
- sophie: continue replay + status pings every 45m
- jamal: finalize customer-facing email and one-click remediation steps for support docs
- olivia: schedule 2 office hours slots (APAC-friendly + EMEA/US)

Please react with :thumbsup: when you have the item. We'll send initial comms within 90 minutes with an acknowledgement and workaround.

ava: working on list now. will also include a CSV for AEs with contact notes. :white_check_mark:

olivia: thanks everyone. once the list is ready I'll assemble segmented email batches (trial vs paid vs renewal-risk). Keep updates short — ping here for any blocker. :eyes:
